layouts.name: Michelin Laurens Proving Grounds
layouts.description: The operator identifies Track 3 as the wet handling course with a 0.45-mile short configuration. This catalogue branch retains the Northern turn-in, middle S, rounded Southern return and Eastern hairpin of that short wet loop. The surrounding dry handling road and outer wet-loop extension are excluded. The centerline is manually digitized only on visible pavement in pinned public-domain 2023 USGS/USDA NAIP imagery. The independent 663.6 m measured route remains unscaled against the 698 m catalogue scalar and the approximate advertised 0.45-mile length; a 45 m catalogue allowance retains historical corner and surface-path differences as a draft limitation. No catalogue image vertices or timing positions determine these coordinates. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 663.6 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
